standard_prerequisites.reference: The definitions of the entropy and of the critical exponent of a Theta-Anosov subgroup, the cones of weights appearing in the statement, and the comparison of Cartan and Jordan projections of proximal elements.
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies background that the delivered proof uses. The entry is declared as a dependency; it is not re-proved on the card, and the load-bearing steps of the counted statement are carried out inside the delivered span.

core_obligations: Prove that for a Theta-Anosov subgroup the entropy is at most the critical exponent for every weight in the relevant cone, that equality holds on the Weyl chamber part, and that equality holds everywhere for a Zariski dense subgroup.
proof_roadmap: Step 1: bound the entropy by the critical exponent using the comparison of Cartan and Jordan projections for proximal elements. Step 2: on the Weyl chamber part recover the reverse inequality so that the two quantities agree. Step 3: for a Zariski dense subgroup extend the equality to the whole cone of the statement.
